svg.title: jfkit dedupe, dry run
svg.desc: A dry run of jfkit dedupe over three invented films: one safe to resolve, one kept as two different cuts, one blocked because the best copy does not play. Nothing is changed.
svg.text: jfkit dedupe — dry run, nothing changes
